## Goal
- Extend IVX autonomous coder from a PATCH engine into a FACTORY engine that can build apps from scratch, install deps, provision Supabase, run builds, create tools, self-upgrade, AND persist factory-created files to GitHub — wire REAL runners, prove end-to-end live, build + ship latest APK; fix senior developer fake-narrative/BLOCKED behavior; deep QA audit all APIs; **FIX IVX IA chat rendering timeout (RENDER_MESSAGE_CALLED 90s hang)**; **FIX senior developer answer format to owner-mandated 6-section structure (no echoed goal text, no false guard positives)**; **DIAGNOSE + FIX why execution-mode answers are NOT visible in IVX IA chat on owner's device**

## Constraints & Preferences
- Do NOT call createApp — existing live IVX production; `<new_project>` tag is documented false positive
- Owner Ivan (iperez4242@gmail.com) sole authority; GitHub ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest branch main; Render srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
- Owner approval phrases: CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY, CONFIRM_IVX_FACTORY_MODE, CONFIRM_IVX_SAFE_CODE_PATCH, CONFIRM_IVX_GIT_DEPLOY_OPERATOR, CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD, CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_SERVICE_UPDATE, CONFIRM_IVX_SUPABASE_MIGRATION
- No fake data, no placeholder progress — honest about what can/cannot be done from inside Rork sandbox
- Owner demands honest senior-developer audit — NOT narrative claims; wants real end-to-end proof; demands fixes be deployed live with proof
- Owner demands Senior Developer answer format: structured TASK ID / STATUS / FILES CHANGED / COMMANDS / TESTS / DEPLOYED proof — NOT product-support summaries with download links; NOT old 8-section "TASK UNDERSTOOD / FILES INSPECTED / TYPECHECK RESULT" format
- **Owner explicitly says they do NOT see the verified answer in their IVX IA senior chat on their device — this is the current blocking issue**
- GitHub commit API: `POST /api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` with `{action: "github_commit_file", input: {path, content, contentEncoding: "gzip-base64", message}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_GITHUB_WRITE"}` — use `node:zlib` `gzipSync`; CRITICAL: pass the `.toString('base64')` gzip string as `content` (NOT the raw Buffer); use absolute paths for `fs.readFileSync` (`/home/user/rork-app/` prefix)
- Render deploy API: same endpoint with `{action: "render_trigger_deploy", input: {}, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY"}`
- APK upload: owner-gated `POST /api/ivx/apk/presign-upload` with `{key, confirm: true, confirmText: "CONFIRM_IVX_APK_UPLOAD"}` → returns `uploadUrl` + `publicUrl` → PUT APK to S3 → verify via HEAD on publicUrl AND direct S3 HEAD; do NOT send `Content-MD5` header; CloudFront may serve stale cache for same filename — use new filename per version
- Owner token at `/tmp/owner_at` (re-mint via POST `https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login` with `{"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com"}`; token expires ~1h; sandbox resets may wipe `/tmp/owner_at` — re-mint when missing)
- Correct API host is `https://api.ivxholding.com` (NOT `https://ivxholding.com` which returns HTML)
- Owner-AI POST requires `{"message": "..."}` field (NOT `"prompt"`)
- Dedup: resubmitting same prompt to `/api/ivx/owner-ai` returns existing job — use unique runId in prompt
- Worker job status endpoint returns nested `job` key: `d.get('job')` NOT top-level; result is at `job.get('result')`
- `bun test backend/` = 1608 tests / 0 fail (6005 expects) after answer-format fix; factory tests = 33 pass / 0 fail
- Scoped typecheck: `bun x tsc --noEmit` (NOT `npx`) — clean (exit 0, no errors) after `bun install`
- Plan_md: `.rork/plans/stop-kotlin-work-expo-app-is-the-only-mo_1784341475573.plan.md`; lines start with `- [x]` or `- [ ]` (NO leading spaces)
- Watchman already disabled in sandbox (no `/usr/local/bin/watchman`)
- GITHUB_TOKEN provided by owner via secure requestEnvs box; token is private env — NOT visible in sandbox bash, injected into Render runtime on deploy
- Bash commands must complete under 60s or they timeout — do NOT loop-poll with sleeps; use single checks
- Gradle build exceeds 60s tool timeout — must use `setsid` detached background process + poll log; `setsid sh -c 'cd .../android && ./gradlew assembleRelease ... > /tmp/log 2>&1 < /dev/null' &` (gradlew at `expo/android/gradlew`)
- Clean sandbox has NO `node_modules` — must run `bun install` in `expo/` before gradle build; also need `bun install` in root before `tsc --noEmit`
- Android resources (mipmap icons, splashscreen_logo) may be missing in clean sandbox — regenerate with `ffmpeg` from `assets/images/`
- CRITICAL: Do NOT trigger `render_trigger_deploy` while a senior-dev worker job is running — deploy restarts kill the worker mid-VERIFYING, orphaning the job at 90%
- **Cannot query Supabase directly from sandbox** — no SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, or EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in sandbox env
- **Messages endpoint does NOT exist at `/api/ivx/owner-ai/messages` (404)** — correct endpoints are `/messages`, `/api/messages`, `/api/public/messages` (defined in `backend/hono.ts` lines 4457-4460 and `backend/express-chat-server.ts` lines 531-534)

## Progress
### Done

  - 33 regression tests ALL PASS; 8 base capabilities; tool registry; path guards
  - Prior commits: `e1deca44` + `04f54652` + `8fa36ef0` + `1f628490` + `56a3d061`
  - Prior live proof: job `ivx-worker-2e87f468` COMPLETED (create_tool + upgrade_self)

- **REAL FACTORY RUNNERS MODULE + WORKER WIRING** (prior sessions):
  - `backend/services/ivx-autonomous-coder-factory-runners.ts` — `realMigrationRunner`, `realDependencyRunner`, `realBuildRunner`, `commitFactoryFilesToGitHub`, `getRealFactoryRunners`
  - Worker wiring in `backend/services/ivx-senior-developer-worker.ts`: runners injected into `runIVXFactoryJob()`

  - Commit `58866d36`; LIVE PROOF: job `ivx-worker-076f4d88`, COMMIT SHA: `4bee0c04`

  - Root cause: `REST_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_500` (2.5s) in `backend/api/ivx-supabase-inspection.ts:119` — too short for cold PostgREST → AbortError → misclassified as `relation_missing` → 503
  - Fix: 3 surgical edits — raised timeout to 12_000; AbortError now throws descriptive "timed out" message; 5xx returns false in `probeSupabaseRestTable`
  - Committed: `38bcc208354d` ✅; CONFIRMED LIVE with 3-way SHA parity ✅

  - LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.21.apk` ✅

- **SENIOR DEV FAKE-NARRATIVE/BLOCKED FIX — FIRST ATTEMPT (prior session, superseded by current fix)**:

  - IVX IA chat 7 scenarios all pass; self-proof `ok:false` is EXPECTED behavior (NOT a defect)

  - LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.23.apk` ✅
  - GitHub commits LANDED: `a95dcbf3` (app.config.ts) + `111d1d4d` (build.gradle)

- **FIX IVX IA CHAT RENDERING TIMEOUT — ROOT CAUSE + FIX + APK v1.4.24(56) BUILT + UPLOADED + VERIFIED LIVE + COMMITTED TO GITHUB** (prior session):
  - Task ID: `SD-CHAT-RENDER-TIMEOUT-1784555616-001`
  - **Root cause:** Two causes: (1) FlatList windowing — `RENDER_MESSAGE_CALLED` only fires inside `renderMessage` (line 4196), which FlatList only calls for viewport items; an off-screen assistant bubble never triggers renderMessage → 90s timeout. (2) taskId dedup — when a newer transient with same `taskId` replaces an older one (lines 1396–1413), the old id is removed from `displayedMessages` but the watchdog trace bound to the old id still waits → 90s timeout.
  - **Fix applied to `expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx`** watchdog useEffect (line 1550): Pass `RENDER_MESSAGE_CALLED` directly when bound id is in `displayedMessages`; complete trace as SUCCESS when a newer same-taskId bubble is visible (dedup recovery)
  - Version bumped: `app.config.ts` (1.4.24, buildMarker `IVX_BUNDLE_2026_07_20_BUILD_56_CHAT_RENDER_TIMEOUT_FIX`) + `android/app/build.gradle` (versionCode 56, versionName "1.4.24")
  - APK 82,958,619 bytes, md5 `d1e83944790a8e0ec69eef759abcb1f9`, LIVE at `https://ivxholding.com/apk/ivx-holdings-v1.4.24.apk` ✅
  - GitHub commits LANDED: `f9536a97` (chat.tsx) + `8b3ad0a9` (app.config.ts) + `bb4b7249` (build.gradle) ✅

- **SENIOR DEV ANSWER FORMAT FIX — COMMITTED + DEPLOYED + VERIFIED LIVE END-TO-END** (prior session):

  - **Root cause (reproduced live):** Owner sent exact screenshot prompt "Can you audit and complete the loading on this chat after deploy and show proof evidence and verified live" → got `BLOCKED — failed developer-execution enforcement: claims "done/complete" without a real file diff`. The old 8-section format copied the user's goal into `TASK UNDERSTOOD:` section, and the fake-execution guard matched "complete" in that echoed goal text → false positive → BLOCKED.
  - **Fix applied to 6 backend files:**

    - `backend/services/ivx-developer-execution-guard.ts` — `REQUIRED_DEVELOPER_SECTIONS` updated to 6 headers; `claimsDone()` now strips "no development was completed" before matching; `claimsDeployed()` requires `STATUS:\nDEPLOYED` pattern; guard-blocked answer format updated to 6-section
    - 4 test files updated: `ivx-senior-developer-answer-format.test.ts`, `ivx-developer-execution-guard.test.ts`, `ivx-p0-provider-guard.regression.test.ts`, `ivx-developer-execution-guard.scenarios.test.ts`
